verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents API access and keys (a docs page titled 'API Access & Keys'), so it can issue credentials an agent could use. Its 'fine-grained admin controls' and permissions claims describe what users can do and see, not how API keys are scoped. Nothing shows keys can be limited to specific workspaces, actions or read-only access. Missing for 10: per-key scoping or least-privilege permissions, workspace- or action-level key restrictions, key expiry or rotation details, and any hands-on corroboration.
